intended_object: An auxiliary linear operator on polynomial spaces: an axial lowering path, with a pivot index inserted, composed after a polarization operator. It is used in commutator and partition arguments in the highest-weight/Mickelsson-path development. I inferred this from the docstring and the namespace.
explanation: The definition only bundles a specific composition of two library-internal operators, `axialCoordinateLowerPath` (with the pivot inserted into the start set and appended to the path) and `polarization`. It serves as a shorthand inside a proof namespace about "same-axis diamond residual suffix partitions". It is a technical device for organizing commutator computations. It has no standard mathematical counterpart in the literature and nothing comparable in Mathlib.
